scripts.package-es5: cd dist/netex && cat runtime-es5.js polyfills-es5.js main-es5.js > bundle-es5.js
scripts.package-es2015: cd dist/netex && cat runtime-es2015.js polyfills-es2015.js main-es2015.js > bundle-es2015.js
scripts.bundle: npm run build-prod netex && npm run package-es5 && npm run package-es2015
scripts.build:drugstone: npm run build:prepare && cd build-tmp && npm run build-prod netex && node build-netex.js && cd .. && rm -rf drugsTone-build && cp -r build-tmp/drugsTone-build . && npm run build:clean
scripts.build:drugstone-stable: npm run build:prepare && cd build-tmp && npm run build-stable netex && node build-netex.js && cd .. && rm -rf drugsTone-build && cp -r build-tmp/drugsTone-build . && npm run build:clean
scripts.build:drugstone-dev: npm run build:prepare && cd build-tmp && npm run build-dev netex && node build-netex.js && cd .. && rm -rf drugsTone-build && cp -r build-tmp/drugsTone-build . && npm run build:clean
scripts.build:drugstone-dev-server: npm run build:prepare && cd build-tmp && npm run build-dev-server netex && node build-netex.js && cd .. && rm -rf drugsTone-build && cp -r build-tmp/drugsTone-build . && npm run build:clean
